name: GhostDataTableTable
description: Default renderer for GhostDataTable. Place it inside the root to render a native GhostTable with a header row, sort buttons for sortable columns, and one body row per rendered row. Each column id is an optional cell slot, #<columnId>="{ row, rowId, rowIndex, column, value, getValue }"; with a columns array from defineDataTableColumns, value is typed per column.

props.name: columns
props.description:
Columns to render, in order, matched to the parent `GhostDataTable`
columns by `id` (ids the parent does not have are skipped). Defaults to
every parent column. Pass the same array you give `GhostDataTable` to
type the `#<columnId>` slots.

keyboard.Tab: Moves between the header sort buttons and any focusable cell content in DOM order. No grid or roving cell focus.
